summary: Kittitas County, WA: a 40-ft pole lookout built in 1932 and taken down in 1955. Footings remain on the ridge, reached by a hike past a forest-road gate.

facts.status_note: Tower taken down in 1955; the footings on the ridge are the only remains described

access.note: Reached on foot past a forest-road gate; a 2017 trip report describes no closure, but no source confirms current rules

visit.trail_note: Drive Forest Road 4510 to a gate, then hike the road 0.7 miles and a trail about 3 miles to the high point

events.note: One site lists A. Bernardi as known lookout personnel
Taken down; the register says removed, two sites say demolished

evidence.quote: This 40' pole L-4 tower, built in 1932, was removed in 1955.
This 40' pole L-4 tower, built in 1932, was demolished in 1955.

evidence.supports: placed in the Wenatchee National Forest

evidence.quote: North Ridge had a 40 foot pole tower with an L-4 cab on top. It was built in 1932 and demolished in 1955.

evidence.supports: footings remain at the high point of the ridge
evidence.quote: The trail passes right by the footings at the highest point of the ridge.

evidence.supports: route runs up Forest Road 4510 to a gate
evidence.quote: will become Forest Road 4510 climbing Cle Elum Ridge. Follow to gate.

evidence.supports: 0.7 miles on foot past the gate
evidence.quote: Hike the road past the gate for 0.7 miles.

evidence.supports: about 3 miles of trail to the high point
evidence.quote: Grab the trail on the right and follow for 3 miles to a highpoint

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: US 1368 / WA 268, the 2012 registration, coordinates and 1,805 m elevation all match the cached pages. No corrections. The only staffing name is a single 1933 entry on one site. Access and visit notes come from a 2017 trip report, so confirm the gate and forest road before anyone publishes route advice. Sites say removed or demolished; both mean taken down.
